exploration_assessment.distinct_executed_technical_paths: Two door configuration approaches: swing reversal at original hinge, then relocated hinge with mirrored child positions and subsequent angle tuning; additional camera, lighting and cabinet variants.
exploration_assessment.new_validation_method: Render inspection only; no new geometric or diagnostic validation evidenced.
exploration_assessment.explanation: Six sequential candidate renders were read and subsequent edits made, but there is no explicit comparison or selection judgment. The first swing trial also changed camera and lighting, and the later angle change also changed camera and lighting; no controlled fixed-camera door comparison is established.

failure_or_stopping_observations: All six execution stdout logs report saved render and scene; index.json reports no Python traceback logs. Material.use_nodes deprecation warning is present, not a fatal error.
The first hinge orientation and several camera variants were superseded; no recorded reason for their rejection.
No student top/side view, visibility mask, geometric distance test, contact measurement, or explicit collision check appears in the trace.
Final response reported delivery without a written assessment of improvement or side effects.

candidate_knowledge.problem: Door leaf has insufficient visible presence relative to reference.
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: Reference has broad angled door; checkpoint image shows no comparably broad foreground leaf. The student's exact diagnosis is not stated.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Possible wall hiding or edge-on projection is in evidence/teacher_diagnosis.json, not received guidance and not established as student discovery.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Reverse hinge swing, then relocate pivot and mirror local leaf/panel offsets, finally adjust swing to -25 degrees.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: Parented door assemblies with local coordinates; cross-scene transfer untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Student read sequential camera renders, including final; no explicit comparative judgment or physical clearance check. Evaluator geometry confirms final leaf placement but is not a student measurement.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Camera and lighting changed concurrently; final dark opening remains a thin box in front of an uninterrupted back wall.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Exact reference geometry, hinge attachment, intersections, and causal improvement.

limitations: Teacher diagnosis contains useful hypotheses and proposed checks but teacher and hint were disabled; no teacher-specific suggestion is credited as received.
Scene states and target_geometry.json are independent evaluator outputs, not evidence of student checks or independent regeneration.
Student-visible render reads establish inspection but do not establish explicit comparison, selection rationale, or numerical improvement.
No hidden reference geometry is available; image similarity and physical validity cannot be conclusively established from these observations.
No full-reference image plane is evidenced in the executed source; scene is assembled from Blender geometry.
